channel.title: SCC Online Web Edition - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from SCC Online Web Edition (scconline.com)

item.title: Brand Ambassador/Endorser's liability under Consumer Protection Act: Kerala High Court absolves Actor Mohanlal from liability in Manappuram Finance consumer case
item.description: Kerala High Court on Brand Ambassador Liability under Consumer Protection Act held cannot be held liable for unfair trade practice in the absence of a direct transactional nexus and absolved Actor Mohanlal Viswanathan in Manappuram Finance consumer case.

item.title: Arbitration, Academia, and the Way Forward: An Interview with Prof. Akash Gupta
item.description: Prof. Akash Gupta is an Associate Professor and Assistant Director of the Centre for alternative dispute resolution (ADR)

item.title: Widowed daughter-in-law a 'dependant' under HAMA, 1956; Entitled to claim maintenance from deceased father-in-law's estate: SC
item.description: On a widowed daughter-in-law maintenance claim from deceased father-in-law's estate, Supreme Court held that such claims can be made under S. 22 HAMA, 1956.

item.title: Call for Participation | 6th CHRIST Mediation-Arbitration Competition 2026 by Alternative Dispute Resolution Board, School of Law, CHRIST (Deemed to be University), Bangalore [Competition on 4th-6th February, 2026]: Register by 15th January 2026
item.description: CHRIST University invites participation in the 6th Mediation-Arbitration Competition 2026, a national Med-Arb event in Bengaluru.

item.title: Bombay HC imposes Rs 25, 000 deterrent fine for nylon manja use; fixes parental responsibility, sets up victim welfare fund
item.description: Bombay High Court orders Rs 25,000 fine for nylon manja use on users and vendors , mandates recovery as land revenue, and directs deposit into a "Public Welfare Account" for treatment of victims.

item.title: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas advised J.P. Morgan Services India Private Limited in one of the largest office space transactions in Hyderabad
item.description: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas advised J.P. Morgan Services India Private Limited on one of the largest office space transactions in Hyderabad, involving the establishment of its IT/ITeS operations at WeWork Campus, Skyview Tower 20, Hitech City.

item.title: Delhi HC stays execution of money decrees in Philips DVD Patent dispute
item.description: Delhi High Court upholds findings on infringement and validity, stays execution of damages in the Philips DVD patent dispute

item.title: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas acted as legal counsel to APG Strategic Real Estate Pool N.V.
item.description: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas acted as legal counsel to APG Strategic Real Estate Pool N.V. on the proposed acquisition of its stake in Fleur Hotels Limited by a Warburg Pincus affiliate, following Lemon Tree Hotels' demerger and proposed listing of Fleur.

item.title: Ensuring Transparency and Athlete Representation: National Sports Governance (National Sports Bodies) Rules, 2026
item.description: National Sports Governance (National Sports Bodies) Rules, 2026 introduces a framework to ensure transparency, accountability, and athlete representation in sports governance.

item.title: Dowry Taunts Are Not Always ‘Cruelty’: Bombay HC Draws the Line Under Section 498A
item.description: Bombay High Court holds that dowry taunts, ignoring affairs, and advice to “tolerate violence” don’t automatically amount to cruelty under Section 498A. Read why.
